meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 会在对话开始和你发消息时自动注入项目静态规则;修改文件后会匹配并注入专属规则。附加输出去重,且不改动工具结果。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 行为、项目规则、环境配置等话题时触发;插件启用后,在会话开始和提交提示时也会自动注入。

say.text: 这个项目会自动注入哪些规则？
say.note: 列出规则文件来源和匹配方式。

say.text: 如何调整 Codex Rules 的生效范围？
say.note: 说明 CODEX_RULES_MODE 等环境变量。

say.text: 规则文件支持放在哪些位置？

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude automatically injects static project rules at conversation start and when you send a message; after modifying files, it matches and injects file-specific rules. Extra output is deduplicated, and tool output is not rewritten.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, project rules, or environment configuration; once enabled, it also automatically injects rules at session start and on prompt submission.

say_en.text: What rules will be automatically injected for this project?
say_en.note: Lists rule file sources and matching behavior.

say_en.text: How do I adjust the effective scope of Codex Rules?
say_en.note: Explains CODEX_RULES_MODE and other env vars.

say_en.text: Where can rule files be placed?
